long_biography.plain_text:
Before building GTIS Partners, Tom Shapiro worked at Tishman Speyer, where he led global equity capital markets and dispositions and served on its investment and management committees. His experience placed him at the intersection of property transactions, capital raising and asset management. In 2005 he formed a real-estate investment venture with GoldenTree Asset Management; it later took the GTIS name.

As president and chief investment officer, Shapiro oversees the firm's investment strategy. GTIS began with opportunities in Brazil and expanded into United States residential property, including single-family rental housing. Its platform also spans development and active management of office, industrial and hospitality assets. The partner-owned firm adopted the Brightshore Capital name in 2026, with Shapiro continuing as president.
